meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the existing bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares, considering polarity.

assignments.reason: The act of truly binding oneself to true Tzaddikim shares the essential nature of the upper wisdom pole. The Tzaddik (רב) is Package 1's human image; binding to the Tzaddik is binding to the channel of חכמה עלאה. This is not a separate domain — it is the human act of connecting to the upper wisdom that the Tzaddik embodies.

assignments.node_id: לתשובה שלמה ולכפרת עוון, ונמתקין הדינין ונתבטלין לגמרי, ונעשה על־ידי־זה יחוד קדשא בריך הוא ושכינתה
assignments.node_text: לִתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה וּלְכַפָּרַת עָווֹן, וְנִמְתָּקִין הַדִּינִין וְנִתְבַּטְּלִין לְגַמְרֵי, וְנַעֲשֶׂה עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה יִחוּד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּהּ
assignments.reason: Complete repentance, atonement, sweetening of judgments, and divine unification are the cosmic results of the upper wisdom successfully connecting to the lower. This composite outcome — including יחוד קב"ה ושכינתה — is the realized state of the union driven by חכמה עלאה. It shares the essential nature of מלוי הלבנה (already in Package 1): the fullness that comes when the upper wisdom's light reaches the lower world.

The filling of the moon's blemish is the same essential reality as מלוי הלבנה (already in Package 1 via additions). The Torah states explicitly 'מפגימת הלבנה נעשה מלוי הלבנה'. This is the cosmic image of the upper wisdom restoring the lower — the positive mirror of Package 3's מעוט הלבנה.

assignments.node_id: נמתקין כל הדינים ונתכפרין כל העוונות
assignments.node_text: נִמְתָּקִין כָּל הַדִּינִים וְנִתְכַּפְּרִין כָּל הָעֲווֹנוֹת
assignments.reason: The sweetening of all judgments and atonement for all sins is the same essential reality as the composite effect node of edge 1 — the realized state of divine union. The Torah equates this directly with מלוי הלבנה and the union of the two worlds/wisdoms. It belongs to the upper wisdom package as the positive cosmic outcome of that union.

assignments.node_id: שהצדיק מלביש אור התורה בספורי דברים
assignments.node_text: שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק מַלְבִּישׁ אוֹר הַתּוֹרָה בְּסִפּוּרֵי דְּבָרִים
assignments.reason: The Tzaddik's clothing of Torah light in mundane stories is the active expression of the הלבשה/לבוש/לאמר cluster (already in Package 1) and of שיחת חולין של צדיקים (added to Package 1). This is the mechanism by which the upper wisdom descends into the lower world. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik's upper-wisdom teaching act.

assignments.node_id: מקשר חכמה תתאה עם חכמה עלאה
assignments.node_text: מְקַשֵּׁר חָכְמָה תַּתָּאָה עִם חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה
assignments.reason: The act of connecting lower wisdom to upper wisdom is the same essential reality as וידבר/זווג (Package 1) and חכמה עלאה וחכמה תתאה (Package 1). The union is initiated and driven by the upper pole — the Tzaddik who embodies חכמה עלאה reaches down to join the lower wisdom to its source. The composite concept is already assigned to Package 1; this causal node expressing the same union belongs there as well.
